label: OpenCode Go
limits: "Estimated requests per 5 hours and monthly usage limits by model"; the 5-hour window gets 20% of the monthly dollars and the weekly window 50%. E.g. Kimi K3: 110 req/5h, $15 monthly usage; Kimi K3.1 Pro 147 / $15; Kimi K2.7 Code 1,350 / $60; LongCat-2.0 11,400 / $60; MiniMax M3 3,200 / $60; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 34,670 / $80. Beam Free is unlimited for a limited time.
notes: Monthly usage is expressed in dollars per model at Go's token prices, roughly 1.5-24x the subscription price. Limited-time promos: Gemini 4 Argon at 50% off ($2/$10 per MTok instead of $4/$20) through 2026-11-30; Beam Free is free with no cap for a limited time, in limited regions. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has served the 1017 build since 2026-10-19 (https://x.com/opencode/status/2112220734768779441). DeepSeek is billed at double rates during peak hours (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays). The Muse Spark Contributor variants are cheap in exchange for training on prompts.

label: OpenCode Go Plus
limits: "Higher limits and fewer interruptions", e.g. Kimi K3: 440 req/5h, $60 monthly usage; Kimi K3.1 Pro 588 / $60; Kimi K2.7 Code 4,050 / $180; LongCat-2.0 45,600 / $240; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 69,330 / $160.
notes: Same token prices and promos as Go.
